integrity: The proof independently reconstructs intrinsic facet-normal lengths from the published H-descriptions, derives a sharp all-center upper bound, and checks equality and contact cases. The parallelepiped center family is derived exactly in prefix-sum coordinates; finite computation is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is specific to the canonical Loday realization and the intrinsic Euclidean metric of its affine hyperplane. It does not address other associahedron realizations or circumradii. An equivalent observation may exist as folklore or under older generalized-permutahedron terminology.
title: Loday's three canonical polytopes share one exact Euclidean inradius
